full_text: Intro Power BI Consulting Services We develop an innovative Data Analytics Ecosystem powered by Microsoft Fabric and Power BI to help you visualize your data efficiently. Our Power BI experts create insightful and data-driven dashboards offering current and deep operational analyses at a large scale, providing you with the information you need to stay ahead of your competition with a focus on multi-fold growth. Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Power BI Consulting Services Enterprise-Grade Power BI Consulting Services Think of a large business like a giant puzzle with thousands of pieces scattered in different rooms. Each room will contain information about sales, stock available to sell, or shipping due dates. Our enterprise-level Microsoft Power BI consultants gather all of those pieces into one location. We offer a single screen view so that an organization can see the overall operations of the business with precision. At our leading Power BI consulting company, we provide a clear map for where your business should go in the future. We help your team stop guessing and start making smart decisions based on real facts. Architecting Ecosystems with Microsoft Fabric In the past, businesses faced challenges when trying to grow because their systems would either slow down or crash due to an increase in data. Now, we create scalable ecosystems, meaning that they perform consistently well regardless of whether you have 10 or 10 million customers. Our Power BI consultants build scalable analytics ecosystems by using Microsoft Fabric’s unified data platform which includes data factory, fabric lakehouse, warehouse, and Power BI. Dataflows Gen2 in Microsoft Fabric help create reusable data transformation pipelines that provide access to the same trusted data models for multiple reports and teams. By designing your data in the strategic manner, our Power BI consulting services USA ensure that your business remains at par excellence, and is ready for whatever comes in the future. Why Choose Us For Power BI Services? Custom-Engineered Ecosystems Generic models will ultimately not work as they don't align with the specific scaling trend you will need in your organization. Therefore, we leverage Power BI to develop your organization's ecosystems through a custom-designed data model that matches your company needs and KPIs. The purpose of our Power BI visualization is to achieve an optimal outcome, allowing for the transformation of unstructured data into an overall growth plan! End-to-End Data Mastery To make informed decisions, companies must rely on clean data. Our team of experts can manage the execution of complex data pipelines, the calculation of Dataflow Gen2 transformations, and the management of your data warehouse architecture, thereby ensuring that your organization’s data is structured, trustworthy and ready for analysis. We also ensure that your data pipeline is protected with automation and security protocols while granting you real-time access. Scalability & Security First As the volume of data continues to increase, your systems must also constantly keep pace with your existing infrastructure. Our Power BI consulting firm develops its products using a "Scale First" methodology ensuring that your Power BI system can adequately handle the ever growing amount of data without any degradation of performance. We focus on Row-level security, object-level security, sensitivity labels and Microsoft Purview generation to protect your data. Actionable Training & Support Our Power BI consulting goes beyond file delivery because we provide ongoing support to our customers. At Awesome Technologies Inc., our Power BI consultants empower your team through practical training programs and continuous system improvements. We train your internal staff members so that your organization achieves maximum return on investment from your Microsoft products while sustaining a data-driven workplace culture. DAX Modeling & Performance Optimization DAX allows for both advanced calculations and time-based analyses along with modelling of key performance indicators. It allows us to use our DAX programs (Data Analysis Expressions) to deliver easy access to complex datasets by enabling our clients to analyse their data. This includes creating intelligent data models based on historical behaviour analysis, future activity forecasts and trend identification using complex DAX formulas. In addition, our Power BI specialists work with you to ensure that your organization is able to leverage operational performance so that you can more effectively create dashboards and reduce processing loads from the system, thus allowing reports to be quick and responsive, even at peak times. Modernize with a Trusted US Power BI Partner In the world of business, many still operate using old methods, such as documenting their processes using pen and paper, or performing manual entry of daily transactions into simple spreadsheets. We work with your businesses to “modernize” your processes based on real-time analytics and eliminate the tedious tasks of performing repetitive manual entries of transactions. As we evolve from merely utilizing “descriptive analytics,” which only indicate what occurred in the past, to “prescriptive analytics,” which provide guidance on what to do in the future, we ensure your data will remain protected, by following strict compliance and positioning your company as the business leader. Our Process of Power BI Consulting Services Discovery & Strategic KPI Alignment Before starting the assessment of your data, our Power BI consultants conduct an in-depth analysis of your business's internal processes to identify objectives, problems, and KPIs that impact the success of your business. Data Engineering & ETL Architecture A dashboard is only as effective as the data behind it. Through our Power BI Services, our professional consultants can assist your organization in pulling data from disparate systems (i.e., CRMs, ERPs, APIs, SQL databases) and transforming that data using modern data preparation and ETL techniques (specifically Microsoft Fabric Pipeline and Dataflow Gen2). This allows you to streamline your data preparation, cleanse processes and prepare your data for upload into either a centralized data warehouse or Lakehouse architecture automatically. Bespoke Data Modeling & DAX Development Using DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), we develop data models that allow you to compute the complicated calculated metrics needed for your organization. As part of Microsoft Power BI consulting process, we create scalable schema that can sustain lightning-quick performance even with large volumes of data. UX-Focused Visualization & Dashboard Design We apply UI/UX standards to create dashboards that align with your brand and are easy to use. Our focus is on Action-Oriented Design to create a pathway to take data-driven business decisions, from managers in one region, to C-Level Executives. Our Power BI Consulting Services Scaling your data shouldn’t be a struggle. We act as an extension of your team at every stage of your Power BI journey with our other Power BI services: FAQs Learn How Our Experts assist you in implementing and creating impactful Power BI Solutions What is Power BI and why do businesses need it? Power BI is a Microsoft-based business intelligence/analytics platform allowing users to visualize disparate data sources in a unified manner through immersive visualizations. Businesses need Power BI to remove “data silos.” Can small businesses use Power BI consulting? Yes! Many small companies use Power BI as a means to get enterprise-level insights without the costs associated with maintaining a full-time data team. How much does Power BI consulting cost? Typically, fees range from $150 to $250 per hour for service-based consulting. For project-based consulting, fees can start at $3,000 for basic implementations, but can exceed $50,000 to implement a complete Enterprise-wide data ecosystem. What are the advantages of Power BI? One of the primary benefits of Power BI to businesses is its complete compatibility with other Microsoft products. Using these compatible programs allows for continuous updates of data and has been identified as having the highest level of security. How long does a Power BI implementation typically take? Typical Power BI implementations take from 4 to 8 weeks to complete. The process can take longer or shorter depending on the current state of your business’ database. If you use our Power BI implementation services, you will have a fully automated and centralized source of information for your business at a reasonable cost in the fastest possible time. Can Power BI integrate with non-Microsoft software like Salesforce or SAP? Yes, Power BI contains hundreds of out-of-the-box connections, including Salesforce, SAP, Google Analytics, SQL database, etc. What is the difference between Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service? Power BI Desktop is the free version of the software designed to allow users to create and maintain reports. On the other hand, the Power BI Service is an online version specifically designed for sharing and collaborating with others who have access to shared reports. Is Power BI better than Excel for data analysis? Power BI has made it easier than Excel to analyze data by providing larger amounts of data (datasets) more quickly and automatically (by using connected data sources) through visualizations (dashboards) enabled by other Microsoft products (Excel).
